visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair, wearing a tan hoodie and a black lanyard, stands in an office setting. He gestures with both hands as he speaks directly to the camera. Large text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom. (2) The man continues his explanation, moving his hands expressively to simulate counting or handling items. Graphical overlays, including a cartoon figure of a detective and dollar signs, appear around him. (3) The man looks slightly to the side, then back to the center, simulating a conversation. Mathematical formulas and various icons (like a calculator and mobile phone cases) float as overlays during his narrative. (4) A caption identifying a different person appears as the man continues to speak. He shrugs and uses his hands to emphasize the difficulty of managing a business. (5) The video concludes with the man looking into the camera with a tired, slightly frustrated expression, eventually closing his eyes and sighing as a final text overlay appears.

(5) [Subtitle]: 如果會計又沒發現. 3000塊就他放口袋了. (6) [Subtitle]: 或者 是 改單「收3000」. 應收帳款就變成2700. 你懂我意思吧. (7) [Logo]: 會計柯姐. [Subtitle]: 可是你可以從日誌表看得到（修改紀錄）. (8) [Variety]: 誰會去看日誌表. 不會去看. 老闆很忙滴. 我那麼忙怎麼可能去看那麼多東西. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice begins speaking with high energy and clarity over an upbeat acoustic guitar BGM. A 'pop' SFX punctuates the transition of a graphical text overlay. (2) As the speaker describes a scenario involving money, a cartoonish 'boing' and digital UI 'ding' SFX are layered into the track. The vocal pitch rises to emphasize points about theft. (3) A female voice briefly interrupts with a questioning tone. The acoustic BGM continues at a steady volume, while a 'whoosh' SFX signals a scene transition. (4) The male speaker returns with even faster speech and higher intensity, articulating detailed business processes. Multiple 'bubble' and 'pop' SFX appear in rapid succession to match visual cues. (5) The speaker lets out a long sigh and says '講完了' (I'm done) with a lower volume and pitch. A final 'ding' SFX marks the end of the narrative, followed by a quick fade out of the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the importance of internal management and access control within a business. By using a relatable scenario about potential fraud or error by employees, the speaker justifies why different staff members have varying levels of authority in a system.
